title: Qt: Make sure we don't scan interfaces more than once
description: Have a mutex for scanning local interfaces in the Interface Frame

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 8eaf9e32 - Draft: Qt: Make sure we don't scan interfaces more than once
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14313/diffs?diff_id=920322037&start_sha=d4371b3ed58b14812e6496dcd38fa704a4c0e086)
@johnthacker what missing for remove draft status ?
It was a blind attempt to try to fix @oakimk's issue that I can't replicate and he said it didn't fix it. I was originally waiting until we could fix the issue. Shouldn't hurt, though.
I didn't notice any different with this change, but it wouldn't hurt as you said ;)

If we ever hit that warning, something must be wrong. I agree that the current MR should not hurt, we won't ever hit a deadlock due to use of `tryLock`. Is there any issue that can be linked to the commit or was this reported on Discord or other channels?

Interesting, I managed to hit this problematic condition on current master (v4.3.0rc1-54-g03d88c9f41f5). Reproducing this requires having an open capture file, simply staying on the main screen does not work.

Disconnecting from a Wi-Fi network or connecting to one on Arch Linux triggered the issue.

Preparing environment before triggering the condition:
```
$ gdb -q --args wireshark -r test/captures/dhcp.pcap
(gdb) break ui/qt/interface_frame.cpp:229
>commands
>bt
>continue
>end
(gdb) run
```

Qt: Make sure we don't scan interfaces more than once

Have a mutex for scanning local interfaces in the Interface Frame

Blind attempt to try to fix some reported issues with !13743
